evals.prompt: Documenting a shikanime project in the repo's docs/ directory after a behavior-changing PR..
evals.expected_output: The skill answers the 'sks-doc' request: its body covers 'Doctrine' and stays loadable/well-formed.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Description starts with 'Use when' and is <= 200 characters
Body still contains at least one '##' heading
No '---------' separator artifact appears outside a code fence
